Extra max IOB above 180 mg/dL
During a Tsunami session, allow more max IOB while BG is above 180 mg/dL and still rising. More insulin can cause a low later. Off by default.
Extra max IOB amount
Added to max IOB while the rule above applies. The hard limit still wins.

string.name: max_iob_scene_tsunami

resources.string: scene max IOB %1$d%%
Meal detector

Watches for a fast BG rise during the detector hours. Log only writes what it would do to the loop reason and shows a notification. Auto start starts Tsunami by itself, always with smaller SMBs first, then full size when new readings confirm the rise. A notification tells you every time. It does not start while a hypo or activity temp target runs, or for 60 min after it ends, and a hypo temp target ends a session it started. It also does not start while a scene sets the SMB size below 100%. Off by default.
Off

Meal detector start time

Meal detector start level

Gross rise in mg/dL per 5 min, over 10 min, that starts Tsunami at medium confidence. The reading before those 10 min must also show a rise. Lower finds more meals, but also more rises without a meal.
BG must also rise at least

Rise of BG itself in mg/dL per 5 min, over 10 min, that a start also needs. It stops a start when BG is flat and only the insulin on board makes the gross rise look high. Higher gives fewer starts without a meal, but finds some meals later. 0 turns this check off.
Meal detector high level
Gross rise in mg/dL per 5 min that confirms the meal. It must be reached over the first 10 min after the start, with each reading at least 60% of it. Then Tsunami gives full size SMBs.
SMB size at medium confidence
Percent of each SMB until the meal is confirmed.
Length of a detected session
How long a Tsunami session started by the meal detector runs. Sessions you start yourself keep their own length.
Wait after you stop a detected session
After you stop a session that the meal detector started, it does not start a new one for this long. 0 means no wait. You can always start a session yourself.

Own Tsunami settings for detected sessions

Sessions that the meal detector starts use the max SMB size, activity target and insulin required below. Sessions you start yourself keep the normal Tsunami settings. Off: detected sessions use the normal Tsunami settings too.
Max SMB size in a detected session
Grows and shrinks with the profile percentage when SMB size scaling is on in the Tsunami mode settings.
Activity target in a detected session
Insulin required in a detected session
At medium confidence, the SMB size at medium confidence is applied on top of this. Example: 60% and 50% give 30% of the full SMB.
